risks.guidance: Preservar o bloqueio de linha e executar leituras e escritas na mesma transacao do banco.
Preservar a construcao JSONB no PostgreSQL ou validar explicitamente a equivalencia do JSON Python.
Distinguir erros de negocio de mensagens NOTICE/WARNING e manter a propagacao definida pela origem.

Preserve the exact protected exception scope: Python validation must remain inside the same try boundary as the source block, including invalid-period checks. Keep fallback values and audit behavior identical for errors caught by that block.
